Shaped iteration 0100 as one bounded WM1 original-version measurement in [tasks.json](tasks.json).
Assigned researcher/default/medium, main, 45 minutes and 35 turns; no dependencies or binary transfers.
Read all startup documents once; [startup diagnostics](startup.json) report `ok`, estimated 13,050 tokens.
Inspected iteration 0099's actual record, [report #501](reports/501.json), and both linked study outputs.
The [study](../docs/research/0099-writing-version-effort.md) supports neither a full reading/writing effort ratio nor a 2024 fallback decision.
Its ready follow-up checks one exact original's raw vers/LVSR declarations, separately retaining parser interpretation and authority limits.
The task pins the original, method and parser, stops on missing/mismatched inputs or parse failure, and prohibits fixture substitution.
Expected outputs are one Markdown report and evidence JSON under `docs/research/0100-wm1-version-evidence`.
This narrows an input-version question; it does not demonstrate semantic writing, native compatibility or preservation.
No session can run LabVIEW; semantic encoding/integrity and native validation remain unresolved.
Updated [working memory](../journal/working-memory.md) with the selected step, deferred prerequisites and closed work.
Read the saved task graph back once and manually checked JSON structure, permitted role/options, sections and limits; no shell verification is available to this role.
The downstream plain python3 command checks committed output shape; actual extraction requires prepared inputs and is checked separately.
## What next
Run the single audit, then inspect its actual report and both outputs; preserve any blocker and avoid repeating it unchanged or expanding into a corpus scan. Independently review the effort study before any fallback proposal; otherwise select a concrete remaining prerequisite.
